photos.name: buns-detail-1
photos.summary: Baked cinnamon buns transferred to a white box lined with parchment paper. Buns are golden-brown on top with visible cinnamon swirl layers. Arranged loosely after removal from baking vessels.

photos.name: buns-detail-2
photos.summary: Cupcake tin aftermath — buns stuck to cups with gelatinized sugar residue visible in each well. Tongs gripping one bun mid-extraction. Shows the sticking problem from baking in individual cups without adequate greasing.

photos.name: buns-in-tin
photos.summary: Both baking vessels in the oven — cupcake tin with individual buns on left, Pyrex glass dish with clustered buns on right. Pre-bake or early bake stage, dough still pale and rising.

photos.name: buns-top-view
photos.summary: Overhead view of baked cinnamon buns in Pyrex glass dish. Golden-brown tops with caramelized edges, buns touching and risen together. These are the Pyrex batch that released cleanly compared to the cupcake tin.
